cases.name: Tequia Monea “KeKe” Nails
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Taquia was the devoted mother of two-month-old twins, a son aged 8, and a daughter aged 3. Her life was brutally cut short in an act of senseless violence, leaving her family and community in deep sorrow. Taquia was known for her beauty, strength, and unwavering love for her children. She dedicated herself to their care and upbringing, ensuring they were surrounded by love and happiness. Her sudden and heartbreaking loss has left an irreplaceable void in the lives of those who knew and loved her. "
cases.narrative: He reported shot her in the head and neck and killed her while she was nursing one of her twin babies.
